builds.name: Reference: Protection specialist
builds.goal: Reference for Sona: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A scaling aura enchanter who repeatedly supports nearby allies and chooses a Power Chord effect to damage, weaken or slow. Record aura recipients, Accelerando and selected Power Chord. Offensive real attacks must repay lost ally uptime; damage-reduction/slow chords cannot also be treated as the damage chord. Healing/shield power and timed actives test preserving an allied carry.
builds.summary: Healing/shield power and timed actives test preserving an allied carry.
testPlan: Kit question for Sona: Record aura recipients, Accelerando and selected Power Chord. Offensive real attacks must repay lost ally uptime; damage-reduction/slow chords cannot also be treated as the damage chord.

Start with the early core (Support quest, Moonstone only with useful eligible heals/shields, then the needed active) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Healing/shield power and timed actives test preserving an allied carry. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Only eligible heals/shields benefit; carrying too many actives can reduce practical value.

The route fails Sona's stated kit question: Record aura recipients, Accelerando and selected Power Chord. Offensive real attacks must repay lost ally uptime; damage-reduction/slow chords cannot also be treated as the damage chord.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Only eligible heals/shields benefit; carrying too many actives can reduce practical value.
Full cost 10,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Support quest, Moonstone only with useful eligible heals/shields, then the needed active. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Redemption, Mikael's Blessing, Dawncore are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Active: Sona restores [30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 90 + (0.3) × AP] Health to herself and a nearby allied champion, prioritizing the most wounded. She then begins a new Melody.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for [3] seconds, granting allied champions [25 / 45 / 65 / 85 / 105 + (0.25) × AP] Shield for [1.5] seconds.

Gain a stack of Accelerando whenever you heal another injured ally and every time you protect another ally from at least [25 / 45 / 65 / 85 / 105] damage with this shield.

Power Chord - Diminuendo: Power Chord also reduces physical and magic damage dealt by the target by [0.25 + (0.0004) × AP] for [3] seconds.

Active: She begins a new Melody and grants herself [0.2 + (0.0002) × AP] Move Speed for [3] seconds, extended to up to [7] seconds if she doesn't take damage. 

Melody: Sona gains an aura for [3] seconds that grants allied champions [0.1 / 0.12 / 0.14 / 0.16 / 0.18 + (0.0002) × AP] Move Speed for [3] seconds.

Power Chord - Tempo: Power Chord also Slows the target by [0.5 + (0.0004) × AP] for [2] seconds.

Sona deals [50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage to the nearest two enemies, prioritizing champions. She then begins a new Melody. Gain a stack of Accelerando for every champion you damage with this.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for [3] seconds, granting allied champions an additional [10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage %i:OnHit% on their next Attack within [5] seconds.

Power Chord - Staccato: Power Chord bonus damage ([characterLevelBreakpoints(start=30, perLevel=15, changes=[{"mLevel": 9, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 22.5, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.3) × AP] total magic damage).

Accelerando: Sona gains Accelerando stacks from using her Basic Abilities well. She gains +%i:scaleAH% [0.5] Basic Ability Haste permanently per stack, up to %i:scaleAH% [60] Basic Ability Haste. When she reaches %i:scaleAH% [60] Basic Ability Haste, instead of gaining further stacks her current Ultimate Ability's cooldown is reduced by @Spell.SonaPassive:AccelerandoUltCDR@ seconds.

Power Chord: After using [3] basic Abilities, Sona's next Attack deals an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=20, perLevel=10, changes=[{"mLevel": 9, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 15.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.2) × AP] magic damage and may have an additional effect based on the song Sona last activated.
Hymn of Valor: The Attack deals @Spell.SonaQ:TotalStaccatoDamage@ magic damage instead.Aria of Perseverance: The target deals @Spell.SonaW:TotalDiminuendoWeakenPercent@ less damage for @Spell.SonaW:DiminuendoDuration@ seconds.Song of Celerity: The target is Slowed by @Spell.SonaE:TotalTempoMoveSpeedSlow@ for @Spell.SonaE:TempoDuration@ seconds.
Sona strikes an irresistible chord, Stunning enemy for [1.5] seconds and dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage.

builds.name: Diminuendo AP defense
builds.summary: Test AP as prevention through the W-selected Power Chord.
builds.goal: Test AP as prevention through the W-selected Power Chord.
builds.hypothesis: W chord reduces the target's physical and magic output with an AP term, while W heal/shield also scale with AP. Staff and Dawncore support AP/heal budget, Helia requires champion damage before allied healing. E helps reach the attack needed to apply the chosen chord.
testPlan: Required state: W is last basic cast before Power Chord attack; Seraph earned and ally damaged.
Record incoming physical/magic damage during three seconds after W chord at two AP checkpoints.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Casting Q/E last changes the chord or stepping into range costs more damage than prevented.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The W chord does not state reduction of true damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Staff of Flowing Water, Dawncore, Echoes of Helia, Rabadon's Deathcap, Seraph's Embrace, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Accelerando attack cycle
builds.summary: Trade utility slots for spell-and-attack chords after earned basic haste.
builds.goal: Trade utility slots for spell-and-attack chords after earned basic haste.
builds.hypothesis: Power Chord follows three basic casts and Q-selected chord has a larger AP packet. Nashor and Lich Bane reward the required attack; Censer can activate on an allied W heal and boosts both users' attacks. Earned Accelerando reduces basic cooldowns up to its cap, enabling more chord opportunities.
testPlan: Required state: Finite earned Accelerando, enough mana, Q selected last and attack range available.
Count chords and distinct Spellblade packets over a finite sequence at zero versus capped earned haste.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Mana or exposure prevents enough casts and the attack build loses allied protection.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Accelerando is not free universal haste and does not directly grant ultimate haste before its cap.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Lich Bane, Ardent Censer, Rabadon's Deathcap, Seraph's Embrace, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
